about: Every published edition of the write-up: a commit of the public repository whose message begins with 'feat(writeup): edition N:' (edition 1: the commit that added the handout), derived from the git history by scripts/import_writeup.py. The handout of an edition stays at its commit. 'current' is the edition in this folder; its commit is null until it is published.

current.description: consistent notation in all notes (205 renamings, every local letter declared with its scope, the components of the data written with their argument, the conventions on letters in the overview); the reading edition is now the light edition (short forms licensed by numbered conventions and linked to them, Facts, notes and chapters instead of units, no remarks on how the notes were made); continuous page numbers in every combined PDF
